name: Addressable loop powered Sounder Beacon Base with isolator – Suitable for use with DIL Switch & Xpert Card detectors

subcategory.name: Analogue Addressable Audio Visual & Voice Alarms

family: Loop Powered Addressable Base Sounders, Beacons And SounderBeacons
summary: The Context Plus Addressable loop powered Sounder Beacon Base with isolator is compliant with the European Standards EN54-3 (Sounders), EN54-23 (VADs) and 17.
description: Provides ‘C-3-8’ light distribution (min 0.4 lux over a 3 x 8m cylindrical area).
features: Provides 'C-3-8' light distribution (min 0.4 lux over a 3 x 8m cylindrical area).
Supplied with a BF431QCP quick connect plate and detector spur wires.
14mA alarm current @24V DC (VAD lit, sounder on max).
Group addressing facility allows multiple devices to be operated simultaneously.
7 selectable volume levels and up to 15 selectable tone pairs.
Optional BF330CTLIDW white or BF330CTLIDR red cap available for stand-alone use.
